types.description: Single NC contact block, silver alloy, screw-clamp terminals

document.title: ZBE102 Product data sheet — Characteristics
document.pages: 1–2; marked contact diagram in product photograph on page 1

modelingNotes: Manufacturer-authored datasheet at a Weger mirror. The ZBE102 sheet photographs a block marked ZBE-102 with an NC diagram numbered 1–2; the job's hyphenated identity is preserved.
One single slow-break NC silver-alloy contact block with positive opening. Operator head, collar and enclosure are separate; no additional contacts, lamp or assembly bonding path are included.
The normally closed function does not merge nets. There are no permanent factory links; passive contact endpoints are application-dependent.

EN/IEC 60947-5-1 operational ratings: AC-15/A600 6 A at 120 V, 3 A at 240 V, 1.2 A at 600 V; DC-13/Q600 0.55 A at 125 V, 0.27 A at 250 V, 0.1 A at 600 V. Ith 10 A is thermal current; Ui 600 V at pollution degree 3 is insulation capability; Uimp 6 kV. No scalar nominal voltage or universal switching-current rating is assigned.
Screw-clamp tightening torque 0.8–1.2 N·m. Datasheet permits up to two 1.5 mm² conductors with cable ends per clamp; shared connection policy is not a physical wire-capacity check.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both endpoints of the exact block's marked NC diagram are represented: screw-clamp terminals 1 and 2. This single passive contact block has no supply, return, PE/bond, shield, lighting or communication terminals. Separate operator/collar/enclosure interfaces and their bonding are outside this order's scope.
